mash-1800.notes: ZAKURO_MASH_BUTTONS pattern baked in: cycles A,B,START,SELECT,X,Y,UP,DOWN with a touch tap every 40 frames; blitzes through title / file select / new-game screens

menu-1200.notes: mash to reach gameplay, then open the pause menu (START) and page through it

press-start-1200.notes: periodic START+A to advance menus and dismiss dialogs

title-600.notes: no input; boots to the title screen and idles (the 2026-11-07 baseline run)

walk-combat-1800.notes: mash thru the title/file screens for 1200 frames, then roam in a square pattern while mashing A/B (walking + combat); validated on the EU cart
